limitations: Synthetic synchronous calls to the real deck with native DOM, InventoryView and InventorySurface; not physical pointer/touch/device verification
Baseline and current runs were sequential, one run per density/scenario after warmup; CPU samples include timing noise and instrumentation overhead
MutationObserver counts DOM writes including repeated same-value attribute assignments; not browser paint or compositor work
Render CPU includes pickup render; move CPU includes render when rendering is synchronous, so do not add these totals
RAF intervals are callback cadence rather than presented FPS or GPU timing; no claim of a proportional FPS increase
Fixtures use three cards and shared UI artwork, not a representative full narrative project with arbitrary large textures
reproduction: Serve identical tests/fixtures/gesture-render-benchmark.html and .js against baseline/current runtime trees on separate origins, click Run warmed benchmark, compare visible JSON reports. No storage is read or written.
assetReadiness: Both card-back images explicitly decoded before timing; font readiness awaited and CSS assets warmed, but readiness of every CSS-referenced asset before the first sample was not independently established.
